1. Insurance Policy Overview

This insurance policy ("Policy") is issued by ABC Insurance Company ("Company")
to the Insured. The Insured means the person named in the Schedule of this Policy.
The Policy Period means the duration of coverage from the start date to the end date.
The Sum Assured means the maximum amount payable under this Policy.

The Policy Period begins on January 1, 2025 and ends on December 31, 2025.
The Sum Assured is $50,000.

2. Premium Payment

The Insured must pay the Premium of $1,200 per year. Payment is due on the
first day of each month. Late payment incurs a penalty of 5% per month on
the outstanding amount.

3. Coverage

The Company shall cover losses arising from natural disasters, theft, and
accidental damage. Coverage is subject to a deductible of $500 per claim.
The total annual coverage limit is $25,000.

4. Claims Process

Claims must be filed within 30 days of the incident. The Insured must provide
documentation including photographs and a police report where applicable.
Claims are processed within 14 business days of receiving complete documentation.

5. Termination

Either party may terminate this Policy with 30 days written notice.
Upon termination, the Company shall refund the unused portion of the Premium
on a pro-rata basis, less any claims already filed.
